observed_result.summary: Single instance (second start AlreadyRunning, stale instance.json ignored, eight concurrent clients start one child), restart recovery reconciles Attempted receipts without preparing again, pause and environment identity survive in-process and process-crash restarts, store crash children at every transaction and migration point reopen to exactly the committed state, resource CAS never lets a stale writer win, repeated adapter unavailability gives one call per request and a stable code with no retry storm. N06 (a)/(b) now run through the production supervisor cleanup executor (Supervisor::cleanup_pass, ResourceCleaner port, CleanupHook at the deletion boundary): the replacement N+1 created between the decision and the delete survives and N is gone; Unavailable is retried only by that executor with Backoff spacing (0.5 s doubling), capped at 8 attempts, then SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, with no operation, decision or prompt (in-process, fake cleaner).

limitations: Helper-process crashes and duplicate observers (A17 M02+) are not M01 claims.

N06 executor cases are in-process with a fake ResourceCleaner (M01 ships no production cleaner; M02 adapters add them); a failed operation prepare is still reported once with a stable code and not retried automatically (u10_a17_repeated_unavailable_*: the operations path, a different reading, indexed but not counted toward N06).

Windows: service stop over the named pipe, eight concurrent clients starting one runtime and the a06 kill/restart cases ran natively (e2e_cli_m01); integration_runtime::instance_stale_records_are_ignored and e2e_cli_m01::service_stop_falls_back_to_a_signal_when_the_control_endpoint_is_unusable are cfg(unix) and platform_only macOS/Linux in the case index (ADR-0006 §13.12 item 4).

Linux and Windows binaries were cross-built on the macOS host with zig (glibc floor 2.31 / x86_64-windows-gnu) and executed natively on the hosts; proptest regression files (resolved at compile-time source paths) were not present on the remote hosts, so persisted regression seeds replayed only on macOS; default fixed seeds ran everywhere.

contracts (platform-neutral schema/golden-file checks) and integration_runtime::config_schema_export_matches_checked_in_file read repository files at compile-time paths and ran on macOS only.
